transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I guess… I just don’t really see things getting back on track anymore. The studio, my life, all of it. No matter how hard I work or what payment plan they put in front of me, it feels like it’s not going to change.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days lately?

Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s already there, this heavy, gray kind of feeling. Even in the shop, around the wood and tools… stuff I used to care about, it just feels flat. Sometimes I just stand there and have to push myself to move.
How long have you been feeling this way most days?
A little over two years, I guess. Since I took on the studio mortgage… about two years and a couple months now.

latest_inference.note: The patient has described a depressed mood lasting more than two years, with loss of interest in previously enjoyed activities and a persistent 'heavy, gray' feeling. This duration and symptom profile is most consistent with F33.2 (Recurrent depressive disorder, current episode severe with psychotic features), given the chronicity and severity of symptoms. No features of bipolar disorder (F31) or other mood disorders were endorsed.
